description: This file defines interfaces for system information and subsystem management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes interface definitions for metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption, along with associated enums and notification mechanisms.
external_files: assuming Core::IUnknown is declared in core/IUnknown.h

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing access to system metadata such as build hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Main interface for managing and querying various system subsystems and their statuses, including notifications and version info.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about subsystem updates.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security subsystem information, including callsign.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IInternet
classes.description: Interface for internet connectivity details, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: ISubSystem::ILocation
classes.description: Interface for location information such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IIdentifier
classes.description: Interface for device identification details, including architecture, chipset, firmware version, and a unique identifier.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IProvisioning
classes.description: Interface for provisioning data, supporting iteration over stored information.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IDecryption
classes.description: Interface for decryption subsystem information, supporting iteration over details.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree of the system.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for subsystem updates.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the information for a specific subsystem.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific subsystem.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific subsystem is active.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the hosting application.
